A '''magnatorch''' was a portable illumination device. [[Sirloss Brill|Sirloss]] and [[Tovi Brill]] used magnatorches on [[Makthierse]] at night while protecting their [[laca]] herds.<ref name= "CG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
